not_done: the protocol file for cognition.report still overstates its required set
no decision was taken on which side wins for the remaining field-level disagreements; the executor aligned the published tool to the protocol and left the protocol alone

remaining_difference.why: The protocol file declares ten required fields (assumptions, attempt_id, boundary, claims, confidence, confidence_reason, evidence_refs, input_revisions, supersedes_id, uncertainties, understanding) while the handler uses a subset and the bridge fills input_revisions. Aligning this one means correcting the protocol file to the semantics the server actually enforces - a contract decision, not a schema rewrite, and it is the next step rather than something this round decided.

root_cause: 30 of the 43 published tools carried a hand-written inputSchema while the other 13 read protocol/schemas/commands/<kind>.schema.json directly. Writing the same contract twice is how the two drifted apart.
